name: pf-fix-firearms-poses
about: fix-firearms-poses against the built package firearms instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). The gun poses (2026-10-22, the user's items 4 and 5; Pose.as, rotated gun models swapped into the held item): the rifle aims down walking, straight the whole time it fires, down 1 s after the last shot or at once on a dodge, up while reloading, 45 degrees up for the launcher and straight for full auto; two pistols aim up walking, straight while firing with a 100 ms kick on the hand that just shot, down while reloading. Through the fix_firearms_feel bot: the pose log lines per state and a frame of each pose; `hwp firearms pose` reports the state.
